Predicates:
Allowed(x) ::: Pets are allowed in building x.
RequiresDeposit(x) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment in building x.
EqualDeposit(x) ::: The security deposit in building x is equal to one month's rent.
MoreDeposit(x) ::: The security deposit in building x is more than one month's rent.
Owns(tom, fluffy) ::: Tom owns a pet cat named Fluffy.
Pet(x) ::: x is a pet.
ManagedBuilding(x) ::: x is a managed building.
MonthlyRent(x, $2000) ::: The monthly rent at building x is $2000.
MoveInWith(x, y) ::: Person x is allowed to move in with pet y.
Conclusion:
Renting(tom, oliveGarden) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in The Olive Garden.
Predicates:
∃x (ManagedBuilding(x) ∧ Allowed(x)) ::: Pets are allowed in some managed buildings.
∀x (ManagedBuilding(x) → RequiresDeposit(x)) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment in a managed building.
∀x (RequiresDeposit(x) → (EqualDeposit(x) ∨ MoreDeposit(x))) ::: The security deposit can be either equal to one month's rent or more.
Owns(tom, fluffy) ∧ Pet(fluffy) ::: Fluffy is Tom's cat and cats are pets.
ManagedBuilding(oliveGarden) ∧ MonthlyRent(oliveGarden, $2000) ::: The Olive Garden is a managed building and the monthly rent is $2000.
MoveInWith(tom, fluffy) ↔ (RequiresDeposit(oliveGarden) ∧ ¬MoreDeposit(oliveGarden)) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in a managed building if and only if he is allowed to move in with Fluffy, and the security deposit is no more than $1500.
$2000 > $1500 ::: 2000$ is more than $1500.
Conclusion:
Renting(tom, oliveGarden) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in The Olive Garden.
